note: P4274 (Pro 25:26) — a righteous man who gives way before the wicked is a muddied spring.

dims.v: compromise — the good man giving way before the wicked, and so defiled
the righteous man who gives way/caves before the wicked — the tragedy of the good man compromising, becoming a fouled spring that fails all who looked to him
set against the wickedness before which he wrongly gives way

tsaddiq — 'a RIGHTEOUS man who gives way before the wicked'; when the good man caves to the wicked he is like a muddied spring — his defilement poisons all who depended on his integrity. The righteous must stand, not yield (cf 24:16).
intimidation — the wicked before whom a righteous man wrongly gives way
the wicked before whom the righteous man gives way — the pressure of evil that, when yielded to, fouls the good man's witness
the righteous who yields to him (266095)
set against the compromise it wins from the righteous
rasha — 'who gives way before the WICKED'; the wicked's pressure, when the righteous cave to it, corrupts a clear spring. Evil triumphs where the good man surrenders his integrity.
